description: Retrieve previously saved context from the cache. Returns the saved content or null if not found. Use this at the START of any task to check if you already have relevant context cached, before doing expensive operations like reading many files. Supports glob patterns: "file:*" matches all file summaries, "arch*" matches architecture-related keys.

key.description: The key to look up (supports glob pattern like "file:*")

name: recall_context
